verdict.rationale: Google's product page claims built-in machine-learning insights and predictions of future customer actions. A community user confirms GA4 has in-product 'insights' with plain-text queries, but reports the results 'always get it wrong'. That makes the capability real but thinly documented and of questionable quality. The MCP server and Data API are developer building blocks for external AI use and are not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed first-party documentation of in-product AI insights and suggestions, evidence of recommendation or suggestion features, and positive independent corroboration of insight accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
